questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: One of the following is an example of a metalloid.
explanation_steps: Correct option is (C) Germanium.
Germanium is a classic metalloid; Hg, Zn, Na, Sr are metals.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Which of the following has a noble gas configuration?
explanation_steps: Correct option is (B) Mg²⁺.
Mg²⁺ has the Ne electron configuration (10 electrons).

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Iso-electronic atoms or ions have the same
explanation_steps: Correct option is (C) electronic configuration.
Isoelectronic species have the same number of electrons and thus the same configuration.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: How many electrons are required for the formation of a triple bond in a covalent molecule?
explanation_steps: Correct option is (D) three pairs.
A triple bond shares three pairs of electrons (six electrons).

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: The oxidation number of chlorine in ClO₄⁻ is
explanation_steps: Correct option is (E) +7.
In ClO₄⁻, let x+4(−2)=−1 → x=+7.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Which of the following is a strong electrolyte?
explanation_steps: Correct option is (C) HCl.
HCl is a strong acid and fully ionizes in water.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: The conjugate base of H₂PO₄⁻ is
explanation_steps: Correct option is (B) HPO₄²⁻.
Removing one H⁺ from H₂PO₄⁻ gives HPO₄²⁻.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Which of the following has the largest atomic radius?
explanation_steps: Correct option is (E) Cs.
Atomic radius increases down Group 1; Cs is largest.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: The number of moles of solute in 1 kg of solvent is called
explanation_steps: Correct option is (C) molality.
Molality = moles solute per kg solvent.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Suppose you mix 100 mL of 1.00 M H₂SO₄ with 200 mL of 1.00 M KOH. What is the molarity of the salt produced?
explanation_steps: Correct option is (B) 0.333.
H₂SO₄ + 2KOH → K₂SO₄ + 2H₂O. Limiting KOH: moles KOH=0.2, moles salt=0.1; total volume=0.3 L → 0.333 M.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
options: The solubility of a gas decreases with the increase of temperature.
The solubilities of different substances at different temperatures are different.
The solubility of a substance can be found at any temperature from the solubility curve.
A dilute solution is one which contains a high proportion of the solute.
A solution is a homogeneous mixture of two or more different substances.
questions.correct_answer_text: A dilute solution is one which contains a high proportion of the solute.
explanation_steps: Correct option is (D) A dilute solution is one which contains a high proportion of the solute.
A dilute solution has a low proportion of solute, not high.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Solutions that resist changes in pH are called
explanation_steps: Correct option is (B) buffer.
Buffers resist changes in pH.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: The amount of heat required to change one gram of solid at its melting point to liquid at the same temperature is called heat of
explanation_steps: Correct option is (C) fusion.
Heat of fusion melts solid at the melting point.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Rate = k[A][B]². If concentrations of both A and B₂ are tripled, the rate will
explanation_steps: Correct option is (A) increase by a factor of 27.
Rate ∝ [A][B]² → factor 3 × 3² = 27.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Which of the following is not a property of a non-metal?
options: It reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid.
It generally has low melting and boiling points.
It has oxides which are usually acidic.
It is generally brittle in the solid state.
questions.correct_answer_text: It reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid.
explanation_steps: Correct option is (A) It reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid.
Non-metals do not typically react with dilute HCl like many metals do.
